ns2:section.sectionText: *Students must register for both the lecture and one discussion section. Due to preparation in their CS course sequence, students currently in the CS+ADV major ONLY may use completion of MATH 220/221 in place of statistics as the pre-requisite for this course. ADV majors must complete a statistics course and cannot substitute calculus as a pre-requisite to take ADV 281. Students who are planning to apply to transfer into Advertising for Spring 2025 will not be able to register for ADV 281 until they have been admitted into the major. There are NO exceptions. Spaces will likely be available in this course for admitted ICT transfers to register in January when admission notifications are sent out. Due to major and transfer demand, seats in ADV 281 will not open to campus in Spring 2025.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Computer Science & Advertising major(s).
